ABSTRACT 
In a method for synthesizing 1 , 1 - diamino - 2 , 2 - dinitroethyl 
ene ( FOX - 7 ) or an N - substituted diamino derivative thereof 
or a salt of 1 , 1 - diamino - 2 , 2 - dinitroethylene or of the N - sub 
stituted diamino derivative , a carbodiimide is reacted with a 
dinitromethane anion . The reaction of the carbodiimide with 
the dinitromethane anion takes place in a solution .
